arguments.name: hotspots-cpu-v3
command:
for tide_case in fc-k hb-lattice-k; do
 for tide_precision in fp32 bf16; do
  for tide_mode in inference train; do
   python -m benchmarks.hotspots --config configs/${tide_case}.json --device cpu --precision ${tide_precision} --mode ${tide_mode} --threads 32 --batch 8 --length 128 --candidates argsort compact bucketed head_query both --warmup 1 --steps 3 --output {run}/${tide_case}-${tide_precision}-${tide_mode}.json || exit
  done
 done
done
